overworked.name: QUIET RECHARGE
overworked.quote: 你不是失去光，只是正在靜靜回補能量。
overworked.description: 你看起來仍然得體，但肌膚正在提醒你慢慢回補。這不是失去光澤，而是身心能量需要重新整理，讓皮膚有空間恢復柔和明亮。
overworked.quoteEn: You are not losing your glow. You are quietly recharging.
overworked.descriptionEn: You still look composed, but your skin is asking for replenishment. This is not about losing radiance; it is about giving your energy system enough room to recover softly.

stress.name: HIGH SENSITIVITY OPERATOR
stress.quote: 你不是太敏感，你只是接收得比別人更多。
stress.description: 你的肌膚感知力很高，容易把生活中的壓力與刺激轉化成可見訊號。這不是脆弱，而是你的身心系統接收得更細、更快。
stress.quoteEn: You are not too sensitive. You simply receive more than most.
stress.descriptionEn: Your skin is highly perceptive, translating pressure and stimulation into visible signals quickly. This is not weakness; it is a finely tuned system asking for calm.

hidden_aging.name: STRUCTURED LIVING
hidden_aging.quote: 你看見細節，是因為你正在為未來留位置。
hidden_aging.description: 你對細節與節奏有很高覺察，會比別人更早看見面部狀態的微小變化。這不是焦慮，而是一種長線照顧自己的能力。
hidden_aging.quoteEn: You notice subtle shifts because you are making room for the future.
hidden_aging.descriptionEn: You are sensitive to detail and timing, noticing subtle facial shifts early. This is not anxiety; it is a long-game approach to caring for your future self.

recovery.name: RECOVERY MODE
recovery.quote: 休息不是停下來，而是肌膚正在重建。
recovery.description: 你的肌膚正在進入修復模式，最需要的不是加快，而是讓身體重新呼吸、循環和回穩。當節奏慢下來，皮膚才有力重新建立狀態。
recovery.quoteEn: Rest is not stopping. It is your skin rebuilding.
recovery.descriptionEn: Your skin is entering recovery mode. Instead of pushing harder, it needs breathing room, circulation, and a slower rhythm so it can rebuild its condition.

preventive.name: BALANCE BUILDER
preventive.quote: 你的穩定，是一種值得被守住的光。
preventive.description: 你的肌膚狀態有一種安定感，重點不是大幅改造，而是把平衡慢慢建立得更穩。穩定本身，就是你最值得保護的光。
preventive.quoteEn: Your steadiness is a glow worth protecting.
preventive.descriptionEn: Your skin carries a steady quality. The goal is not dramatic transformation, but building balance carefully so your good condition can last.

glow.name: GLOW EXPLORER
glow.quote: 你追求的不是完美，而是皮膚真正接住光。
glow.description: 你對光、透明感與細節有很強的審美直覺。你追求的不是完美無瑕，而是皮膚本身能乾淨、清澈地接住光。
glow.quoteEn: You are not chasing perfection; you are following the way your skin catches light.
glow.descriptionEn: You have a strong instinct for light, clarity, and detail. You are not chasing flawlessness; you are exploring how your skin can look clearer and more naturally radiant.

burnout.name: CONSTANT ACCELERATOR
burnout.quote: 你不是不夠努力，你只是一直在高速前進。
burnout.description: 你的生活節奏長期維持高速，皮膚也一直在努力追上。現在最需要的不是再加速，而是重新調整節奏，讓能量慢慢回到身體裏。
burnout.quoteEn: You are not behind. You have been moving at high speed for too long.
burnout.descriptionEn: Your lifestyle has been moving at high speed, and your skin is trying to keep up. What it needs now is not more acceleration, but a slower rhythm that lets energy return.

late_night.name: NIGHT OWL CREATOR
late_night.quote: 夜晚給你靈感，也提醒你的肌膚需要節奏。
late_night.description: 你在夜晚擁有靈感與專注力，但肌膚同時需要更清晰的節奏。當作息被重新校準，眼周、氣色與精神感會更容易被喚醒。
late_night.quoteEn: The night gives you ideas; your skin is asking for rhythm.
late_night.descriptionEn: The night gives you focus and imagination, but your skin is asking for a clearer rhythm. With a steadier reset, your eyes and complexion can wake up more easily.
